snippet.title: Wartales | The Beast Hunt | RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Wartales - The Beast Hunt is out now!

Every decade, a monstrous force of nature awakens, leaving only ruin in its wake. For generations, the Trackers have fought to contain the curse. But this time… they need you. 

Buy now on Steam: https://shiro.li/0OyqaL
